releaseScope: Initial route search and manual recalculation remain direction-agnostic.

Only sustained off-route automatic rerouting may add a reliable travel heading. Raw GPS heading is used only with accurate fixes and moving speed; otherwise a sufficiently long accurate movement vector is used, otherwise no heading constraint is applied.
The relay converts that optional auto-reroute heading into an ORS start bearing sector while preserving driving-hgv and the exact registered vehicle restrictions.

MAP current-position follow mode uses route geometry to detect a significant upcoming bend and changes at most one Leaflet zoom level per GPS update toward zoom 16/17/18/19 as the turn approaches, then relaxes again after the turn.
FINAL.40 highway/JCT discovery and FINAL.36 detour safety caps remain unchanged.

validationEvidence.officialProviderContract: ORS Directions supports waypoint bearings; optimized=false is required when bearings are used.

decision: Apply direction only to automatic off-route rerouting; initial and manual route searches stay direction-agnostic.
Never force a direction when the GPS evidence is not reliable enough; fall back to ordinary HGV rerouting without a bearing.
Turn-aware zoom runs only while MAP current-position follow is ON and moves one zoom level per GPS update.
Keep driving-hgv, exact vehicle restrictions, highway safety logic, provider call guards, and no-car/no-straight-line fallback unchanged.
Keep AN15 learned numeric promotion intentionally paused and do not restore OCR/Analysis.
